# Revised Execution Plan After Frame-Six Evidence

The Awtsmoos breaks one opaque failure into smaller vessels that can each be measured; Awtsmoos.com will trust no queue, flush, or codec lifetime that has not survived real moving frames.

## Source pass
- Rewrite `scripts/awtsmoos/video/base/StableWebCodecsVideoEncoder.js` completely.
- Preserve AVC-only registration and MediaBunny packet callbacks.
- Add native encoder construction as a focused method.
- Force segment-opening keyframes.
- Drain and retire every native encoder after three frames.
- Make final `flush()` idempotently drain only an active partial segment.
- Rewrite `apps/animator/tests/sharedMovie/stableWebCodecsEncoder.test.mjs` completely to validate two consecutive segments.

## Test pass
- Run all shared movie + Animator sharedMovie tests.
- Syntax-check every touched shared-video and export module.

## Runtime pass
- Fresh no-cache 30-second render.
- Verify progress past 6, 12, 120 and 360 frames.
- Persist MP4 through receiver and ffprobe it.
- Fresh full 180-second render.
- Persist, ffprobe, extract seven encoded frame witnesses.

## Remaining closure
Continue afterward with mobile director proof, relevant existing tests, oversized legacy file split, hygiene/readback, evidence refresh, delta, untracked-source audit, handoff and final hidden-work discovery.
